integrity: The infinite classification is proved analytically. The bundled exhaustive computation is used only as a finite stress test. Literature noncoverage is reported as a search-based assessment with an explicit residual risk.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to matching deletions from complete bipartite graphs and to positive-integer levelability; it does not classify arbitrary edge deletions or the entire real well-covered vector space.
title: Levelability threshold for matching-deleted complete bipartite graphs
